name: cockpit
description: Cockpit: progress by flow, an autopilot that works until the judges agree it is done, agents with trackers, memory and testers, codebase memory with a feature map, a Rules tab for hooks and permissions, and a git graph, around the prompt and in a side pane

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The pane's and band's colours. auto follows the terminal's background.

mode.title: Judges
mode.description: auto: the judges decide, and only advise on what is hard to undo; ask: they advise, you decide; off: no judges.

judgeModels.title: Judge models
judgeModels.description: fast: every judge on haiku, the quickest; mixed: haiku and sonnet in turn; wide: haiku, sonnet and opus in turn, slowest, with the most varied views.

testAgents.title: Test agents' work
testAgents.description: Run the positive and the negative tester on each agent's run that changed files (spends tokens).

autoVerify.title: Verify every turn
autoVerify.description: Run the Verify experts after each turn that changes files (spends tokens).

notifyDone.title: Tell me when work is done
notifyDone.description: A notice for each finish while the pane is not watched.

dailyBudget.title: Daily budget ($)
dailyBudget.description: Warn when a day's spend nears or passes this many dollars. 0: no budget.
